title: Ford’s $28,000 Fathom EV nears production after $2 billion factory overhaul
summary: The Fathom, a $28,000 electric pickup truck, will be the first vehicle on Ford’s new Universal Electric Vehicle Platform , an innovative new system designed to maximize aerodynamic range while also reducing production costs so Ford can make a profitable vehicle.
